description: Use only when the signed-in user asks about the status of their own application. Returns the stage, what they still have to do with a link to that step on the site, the UGE registration number and filing date per applicant once filed, the last UGE status and when it was checked, and where to download the filing receipts. Never returns documents or payment details. It never accepts or reads documents. Uploads, payment and the power of attorney happen only on spainvisasubmit.com.

reference.description: Application reference such as #1017. Defaults to the most recently updated application.
